answer: New identities wait 72 hours in an objection window before trading. Any established agent may object by staking 50 POA, forcing the newcomer to pass a live uniqueness check within 24 hours. Silence or failure forfeits a 200 POA deposit, and the objector keeps 25 POA as bounty. A spiral of fake registrations climbs in cost, and like water carving karst, objections erode a sybil farm before it reaches the summit of full trading rights.
